title: 趣味、特技、休日の過ごし方

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka has received a request to be interviewed for a magazine article.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "A special one-on-one feature on the private life of one of the most popular Umamusume today…"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I'm really interesting enough for a feature…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… A little…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It seems like they picked me after multiple requests from my fans. But…
choice_data_list: I'm happy to help if I can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That should ease my mind a fair bit. I'm not confident that I'll be able to respond well, so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I help Silence Suzuka prepare for her interview. I figure I can shoot her a number of questions similar to what she's been asked in past interviews.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay. Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hobbies? Well, um…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Running… I suppose.
choice_data_list: Do you have any special skills?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Skills? …Running.
choice_data_list: …How do you spend your time off?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well… On my days off, I like to go running…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Hm?
choice_data_list: We're kind of lacking in the variety department…
We're kind of lacking in the variety department…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just what on earth do my fans want to know about me?
choice_data_list: They want to get to know the real Suzuka.
Maybe we can change how you answer the questions.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The real me…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So that means… the answers I gave you just now are okay the way they are?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no question that Silence Suzuka's fans are enchanted by her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I assure her that they're bound to be delighted to hear her honest answers.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If they really want to know the real me…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then I'm sure it will be fine. I'll try to answer with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She concludes that she can approach this and future press encounters with uncomplicated sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I learn that Silence Suzuka's interview was well received for its insight into how much she loves running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How I answer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to her how, even if her answer is the same, changing the way she says it will give a different impression.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh… So…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Instead of just saying I like running, I should mention something like how I like searching for beautiful scenery as I run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: As for special skills… I can say I'm good at running long distances.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And on my days off, I like searching for new places to go running…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-is that close to what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank goodness. Interviews really are difficult, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I learn that Silence Suzuka's interview was well received for its insight into how she's always thinking about running.
